name: .S3methods
title: List Methods for S3 Generic Functions or Classes

origin.description: List all available methods for an S3 generic function, or all methods for an S3 class. The result is a character vector of method names with class ``MethodsFunction`` and an ``info`` data frame attribute.
origin.usage: .S3methods(generic.function, class, envir = parent.frame(), all.names = FALSE, dropPath = FALSE, useEnv = FALSE)

arguments.name: generic.function
arguments.description: Character string naming an S3 generic function.

arguments.name: class
arguments.description: Character string naming an S3 class.

arguments.name: envir
arguments.description: Environment in which to look for the generic.

arguments.name: dropPath
arguments.description: When true, keep only ``.GlobalEnv``, the attached environment, and ``package:base`` on the search path.

arguments.name: useEnv
arguments.description: Attach ``envir`` at search position 2 while collecting methods.

origin.details: Registered methods from namespace ``.__S3MethodsTable__.`` entries are merged with visible objects on the search path. Names on ``tools::nonS3methods(NULL)`` are dropped.
origin.value: A ``MethodsFunction`` character vector with ``info`` and ``byclass`` attributes.
origin.example:
library(utils)
g <- "killrS3methodsProof"
e <- new.env()
assign(g, eval(parse(text = sprintf("function(x) UseMethod(\"%s\")", g))), envir = e)
assign(paste0(g, ".alpha"), function(x) x, envir = e)
assign(paste0(g, ".beta"), function(x) x, envir = e)
res <- utils:::.S3methods(g, envir = e, useEnv = TRUE, dropPath = TRUE)
paste(sort(res), collapse = "\n")

translation.description: Same S3 method listing for a ``BindingEnviron`` when ``use_env`` is true; other calls delegate to the installed R function.
translation.usage: S3methods(generic_function=None, class_=None, envir=None, all_names=False, drop_path=False, use_env=False)

arguments.name: generic_function
arguments.description: S3 generic name; supply this or ``class_``.

arguments.name: class_
arguments.description: S3 class name when listing methods by class.

arguments.name: drop_path
arguments.description: Restrict the search path like R ``dropPath``.

arguments.name: use_env
arguments.description: Attach ``envir`` as search name ``envir`` while collecting.

translation.details: Uses ``tools.non_s3_methods`` for the stop list and R ``ls`` on ``package:`` paths; ``MethodsFunction`` keeps ``info`` rows as Python dataclasses.
translation.example:
from utils.s3_methods import S3methods
from utils.s3_session import BindingEnviron
g = "killrS3methodsProof"
def _generic(name):
    def method(x):
        raise NotImplementedError
    method.__r_usemethod__ = name
    return method
env = BindingEnviron({g: _generic(g), f"{g}.alpha": lambda x: x, f"{g}.beta": lambda x: x})
res = S3methods(g, envir=env, use_env=True, drop_path=True)
print("\n".join(sorted(res)))
